subject: Next steps: security artifacts, portal invite, and vendor intake
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Monroe <amonroe@medivault.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: security artifacts, portal invite, and vendor intake

Hi Alicia — great to meet you and the team on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Requested artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report for the latest period (PDF) and any available bridge letter or interim attestation for 2028.
2) Trust portal: please invite us to whatever secure portal you use for evidence exchange (email for portal invite: security@redwood.com). If portal access isn’t possible, SFTP or signed Link is fine.
3) Vendor intake: we have a short security intake + DSQ that you'd asked about — I can send a pre-filled copy to speed things up.
4) Timeline: our procurement/compliance needs a copy of the report and bridge letter (or confirmation of availability) before EOY approval; would you expect to have portal invite and SOC2 files by next week?

Attaching: redwood_bridgeletter_template_v1.pdf (template if helpful) and redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf (internal one-pager explaining what we provide).

If you send the portal invite to security@redwood.com, Priyom will pick up the intake and I’ll loop in our legal if we need any redlines. Thanks again — open to a short follow-up if you'd prefer to coordinate handoff.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---

From: Alicia Monroe <amonroe@medivault.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medivault.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 15:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: security artifacts, portal invite, and vendor intake

Thanks Jordan — enjoyed the demo. Quick answers below.

- SOC 2 Type II: we do have a 2027 Type II report. I can share the redacted PDF. Our compliance team usually requires a signed NDA before sending the full report; we can also provide a redacted copy first.
- Bridge letter (interim attestation): we don’t have a standard market-facing bridge letter, but legal can draft a short attestation stating there are no major control changes since the last report. That should be doable within 3–5 business days once we have a contact for our legal.
- Portal invite: we use SecureDocs for evidence exchange. I will have an admin user invite security@redwood.com today. Expect an auto-email from SecureDocs — if you don’t see it, let me know and I’ll send a share link.
- Vendor DSQ: send your questionnaire link and I’ll route to our security ops; alternatively, send the pre-filled version you mentioned and we’ll confirm.

I’ll follow up with the admin once the portal invite is sent and with legal on the bridge letter timeline.

Regards,
Alicia Monroe
Head of IT Security
Medivault Health

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: security artifacts, portal invite, and vendor intake

Jordan — thanks, added notes to the deal. Two quick internal asks: 

- If Medivault asks for an NDA to release the full Type II, do we have a standard mutual NDA we can send? Legal has an MSA we can attach.
- They may request faster turnaround on the bridge letter; are we comfortable asking for a 30-day implementation confirmation instead of a formal letter if legal stalls? That could keep momentum while we close procurement.

I’ll prepare the pre-filled DSQ and share it in Drive, then upload to the portal once Alicia confirms.

Cheers,
Priyom
Senior Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Monroe <amonroe@medivault.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: security artifacts, portal invite, and vendor intake

Hi Alicia — thanks for the quick turnaround and for initiating the SecureDocs invite. Confirming next steps on our side so there’s no ambiguity: 

1) SecureDocs invite: please send to security@redwood.com. Priyom will be the intake owner and will upload the pre-filled DSQ there. 
2) SOC 2 Type II: redacted copy is fine to start. If your legal asks for an NDA, please point them to our standard mutual NDA (I’ve attached the MSA link in HubSpot). We can sign quickly.
3) Bridge letter: accepted — if legal can produce a short attestation within 3–5 business days that covers no material control changes since the report, that will satisfy our review. If they prefer, a confirmation email from your security lead with comparable language works too.
4) Timing: receiving the portal invite + redacted Type II by next Thu (Jan 18) would keep us on track for procurement review the following week.

Attachments: uploaded redwood_bridgeletter_template_v1.pdf for reference; happy to adapt language if your legal prefers different phrasing.

If helpful I can introduce our compliance counsel on a short call — I think a 20-minute alignment meeting would clear any questions. Do you have availability Fri 1/13 or Mon 1/16?

Thanks again, and let me know when the SecureDocs invite goes out.

Best,
Jordan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
